title_en: Xu Jinliang v. Wang Zhonghai — dispute over unjust enrichment

full_text_en:
Xu Jinliang v. Wang Zhonghai — dispute over unjust enrichment

Plaintiff: Xu Jinliang, male, born in December 1952, owner of Haiyang Store in Antu County, Jilin Province.

Defendant: Wang Zhonghai, male, born in June 1960, self-employed individual in Antu County, Jilin Province.

The plaintiff, Xu Jinliang, filed a lawsuit with the Antu County People's Court of Jilin Province against the defendant, Wang Zhonghai, regarding a dispute over unjust enrichment.

The Antu County People's Court, because the facts of the case were clear, the rights and obligations were unambiguous, and the dispute was minor, conducted the trial pursuant to the summary procedures under Chapter 13 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Upon trial, the following facts were found:

On the morning of July 29, 1995, the plaintiff, Xu Jinliang, rode a tricycle to Haiyang Store, placing RMB 15,680 in a yellow ladies' handbag on the vehicle. After Xu Jinliang rode to the store, he discovered the bag missing and returned along the route to look for it. During this time, a neighbor, Zhao Ningyuan, informed the plaintiff that he had seen Wang Zhonghai's five-year-old son, Wang Xiaodong, pick up the bag. Another neighbor, Yang Hongcai, also saw Wang Zhonghai's son pick up a yellow ladies' handbag. The plaintiff repeatedly approached Wang Zhonghai to demand the return of the lost bag and promised to give several thousand yuan as a reward. However, Wang Zhonghai refused to admit that his son, Wang Xiaodong, had picked up the plaintiff's lost bag. During the trial, witness Zhao Ningyuan testified: "I am Wang Zhonghai's west neighbor. At about 7:00 a.m. on July 29, I was plastering a wall when I heard Wang Zhonghai's son, Wang Xiaodong, shout: 'Dad, I picked up a bag of money.' At that time, I climbed over the wall and saw Wang Xiaodong holding a yellow ladies' handbag." The testimony of witness Yang Hongcai was also presented in court: "On the morning of July 29, near Wang Zhonghai's house in Guangming Hutong, I saw a child shout: 'Dad, I picked up a bag of money.' Then he ran into Wang Zhonghai's yard. The bag containing the money was a yellow ladies' handbag." Wang Zhonghai raised no objections to the above witness testimony.

The Antu County People's Court held: Through the trial, it could be determined that the yellow ladies' handbag containing RMB 15,680 lost by the plaintiff, Xu Jinliang, was indeed picked up by Wang Xiaodong and handed over to the defendant, Wang Zhonghai. Article 92 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "If a person acquires unjust benefits without a legal basis and causes loss to another person, the person shall return the unjust benefits to the person who suffered the loss." Wang Zhonghai's son, Wang Xiaodong, handing over the picked-up bag to Wang Zhonghai should be considered as acquiring an unjust benefit without a legal basis and, according to law, should be returned to the plaintiff, Xu Jinliang. On the basis of ascertaining the facts and distinguishing right from wrong, and in accordance with the provisions of Article 85 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, under the auspices of the court and through mediation, the parties voluntarily reached the following agreement: The defendant, Wang Zhonghai, shall return the yellow ladies' handbag containing RMB 15,680, which was picked up, to the plaintiff, Xu Jinliang.

Court acceptance fee of RMB 637 shall be borne by the defendant, Wang Zhonghai.

Xu Jinliang, satisfied with the mediation result, voluntarily gave Wang Zhonghai RMB 5,000 as a reward.
